description: Search Reddit by keywords with advanced filters, multi-source live/archive fallbacks, comment search, and only-new monitoring. Sources: Google Translate community partial, Reddit RSS, Redlib, Arctic Shift archive, optional user OAuth token.

commentLimit.description: Maximum matching comments per keyword when searchComments is enabled (1-1000).
commentLimit.title: Comment limit per keyword

dateFrom.description: Drop records with `created_at` before this date (inclusive). Format: YYYY-MM-DD or ISO timestamp.
dateFrom.title: Date from (YYYY-MM-DD)

dateTo.description: Drop records with `created_at` after this date (inclusive end-of-day). Format: YYYY-MM-DD or ISO timestamp.
dateTo.title: Date to (YYYY-MM-DD)

excludeNsfw.description: Drop NSFW records. When the available source cannot expose a per-post NSFW flag, unknown rows are not emitted as safe; the run reports nsfw_status_unavailable.
excludeNsfw.title: Exclude NSFW

includeArchive.description: Use Arctic Shift for subreddit-scoped backfill and comment hydration when live sources fail. Archive metrics are snapshots, not live.
includeArchive.title: Include Arctic Shift archive fallback

keywordRequireAll.description: When multiple keywords are given, keep only records whose title/content contains ALL of them. Default: each keyword runs independently (OR).
keywordRequireAll.title: Require all keywords (AND)

keywords.description: List of keywords to search. Each runs as a separate search.
keywords.title: Keywords

maxAgeDays.description: Drop records older than N days.
maxAgeDays.title: Max post age in days (filter)

minScore.description: Drop records below this score. Applied only when the source exposes a live or explicitly timestamped score; otherwise the run reports metrics_unavailable instead of silently passing/dropping.
minScore.title: Min score (filter)

monitorId.description: Key used to store the onlyNew watermark and seen IDs. Use the same value on every scheduled run of the same monitor.
monitorId.title: Monitor ID

onlyNew.description: Emit only records newer than the stored watermark for this monitorId. Requires a stable monitorId for scheduled runs.
onlyNew.title: Only new since last run

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional Apify proxy configuration. Live HTML/Redlib/RSS availability varies by IP; residential proxies improve success on datacenter runs.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

redditOAuthToken.description: Optional user-supplied OAuth Bearer token. Never required; when present, oauth.reddit.com is tried first for live metrics. The actor does not obtain tokens for you.
redditOAuthToken.title: Optional Reddit OAuth token

redlibInstances.description: Optional Redlib hostnames to try in order (without https://). Defaults to safereddit.com, redlib.catsarch.com, redlib.perennialte.ch.
redlibInstances.title: Redlib instances

relativeWindow.description: Restrict results to a relative window. Maps to Reddit's t= and Arctic after= filters. Use all for no window.
relativeWindow.title: Relative time window

resolveChallenges.description: Allow a best-effort Playwright browser solve when a Redlib instance returns an Anubis challenge. Disable to keep runs HTTP-only.
resolveChallenges.title: Resolve Redlib Anubis challenges

resultLimit.description: Max posts per keyword (1-1000). Default 100. Source caps are real: RSS 100/request with no pagination, Translate partial 24/page, Redlib 7/page, Arctic 100/page. Fewer results are reported as partial rather than silently truncated.
resultLimit.title: Result limit per keyword

searchComments.description: Also search comment bodies via Redlib, with RSS parent-post discovery + hydration as fallback. Emits recordType=comment records.
searchComments.title: Search comments by keyword

sort.description: How to sort the search results.
sort.title: Sort by

subredditFilter.description: Only emit posts/comments from these subreddits (with or without `r/`). Empty = all. When set, the engine prefers the subreddit-scoped Translate listing.
subredditFilter.title: Subreddit filter (allowlist)

title: Reddit Keywords Pro Input
